description: This file defines functions, classes, and logic related to managing Parties (Customers, Suppliers), addresses, contacts, accounts, and related financial and logistical details within the ERPNext accounting module. It includes functions for fetching party details, setting address and contact info, validating accounts and currencies, and handling payment terms, taxes, and timeline data.
